lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The coffee's cold in the chipped porcelain mug
Shadows stretch long across the hardwood floor
I’m tracing circles where we used to stand
Locking the deadbolt on an empty door
Every photograph still wears your name
But every smile is fading into gray
[chorus]
Now there’s just static on the line
The ghost of a heart that won't align
It's a heavy ache beneath my skin
Where the silence ends, the storms begin
I scream your name into the night
But every echo dies without a fight
The ashes glow where love had burned
Some fires fade, but never truly turn
[verse]
The neon light flickers in the hall
A steady hum that echoes through the room
I’m rearranging furniture for no one
Just pacing patterns in the graying gloom
Every corner whispers what we were
Every heartbeat only makes it hurt
[chorus]
Now there’s just static on the line
The ghost of a heart that won't align
It's a heavy ache beneath my skin
Where the silence ends, the storms begin
I scream your name into the night
But every echo dies without a fight
The ashes glow where love had burned
Some fires fade, but never truly turn
[bridge]
Was it worth the fall, was it worth the break?
Every promise was a brittle stake
I’m washing memories down the drain
But the residue is all that will remain
[chorus]
Now there’s just static on the line
The ghost of a heart that won't align
It's a heavy ache beneath my skin
Where the silence ends, the storms begin
I scream your name into the night
But no one's left to hear me fight
The ashes glow where love had burned
Some scars remain though pages turn
[outro]
Static fades...
But your echo never leaves.
